name: @campus/database
description: PostgreSQL schema, migrations, seed data and the Prisma client (docs/architecture.md §8)

scripts.prisma:generate: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:deploy: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:seed: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:studio: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma studio
